raw_response:
This plot is my yam and cassava ground, about one hectare, and I own it so I take care of it well. I went to school small-small, so I know NPK helps, but yam likes the old soil and plenty of manure from my goats and chickens more than the chemical bag. Last year I put one bag of NPK 15-15-15 across the mounds and it helped the cassava, so I will do the same this year if the agro-dealer in town has stock when I have cash. I use my own yam setts I kept from last harvest — improved yam seed is costly and hard to find here — but for cassava I will try to get some improved cuttings from my cousin who got them from the ADP last year. Weeding is the big work on tubers, so my wife, my son and me will do most of it, but at mound-making time I must hire small labor because my back is not like before.
